items.question: What happened to Omni Flash 1.1 and its scores?
items.answer: Omni Flash 1.2 replaces 1.1 for new renders on VideoAI. Earlier 1.1 examples, prompts and editorial assessments remain historical evidence. The September 3, 2026 assessment is not a benchmark of 1.2; we have not assigned it to the new version.

items.question: Omni Flash 1.1 及其评分后来怎么样了？
items.answer: 在 VideoAI 上，Omni Flash 1.2 取代 1.1 用于新的生成。此前的 1.1 示例、提示词和编辑评估仍作为历史依据保留。2026 年 9 月 3 日的评估并非对 1.2 的基准测试，我们没有把它归到新版本上。
